success.description: You summon a mighty tempest djinn that knocks all targets within long range off their feet. The targets may not perform movement manoeuvres while this action is recharging, and suffer a penalty to all actions that would reasonably be affected by a raging wind
As above, and all targets suffer 2 + Int damage

conservative.requirements: & Special; Reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc} if under open sky. You may target as many enemies as you like with this although each additional target beyond the first adds {Dc} to the dice pool
